title: Auto Loans: late charge grace days, percentage and cap by state
content:
# Auto Loans: late charge grace days, percentage and cap by state

This schedule sets the state-dependent late charge settings for every Auto Loans product at PCB. Each setting is keyed to the borrower's state of residence: North Carolina (NC), South Carolina (SC) or Virginia (VA).

- **Grace days**: calendar days after the due date before a late charge applies, a whole number.
- **Late charge percentage**: the late charge as a percent of the installment.
- **Late charge cap**: the largest late charge per installment, in USD.

## Schedule (identical on all six products)

The Used Vehicle Loan, Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Loan, Auto Refinance Loan, Lease Buyout Loan, New Vehicle Loan and Green Vehicle Loan all carry the following settings.

| Borrower's state | Grace days (calendar) | Late charge percentage | Late charge cap (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| NC | 15 | 4.00 | 25.00 |
| SC | 10 | 5.00 | 18.50 |
| VA | 7 | 5.00 | 30.00 |

## Same schedule, read by product

| Auto Loans product | NC grace / percent / cap | SC grace / percent / cap | VA grace / percent / cap |
|---|---|---|---|
| Used Vehicle Loan | 15 days / 4.00 / 25.00 | 10 days / 5.00 / 18.50 | 7 days / 5.00 / 30.00 |
| Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Loan | 15 days / 4.00 / 25.00 | 10 days / 5.00 / 18.50 | 7 days / 5.00 / 30.00 |
| Auto Refinance Loan | 15 days / 4.00 / 25.00 | 10 days / 5.00 / 18.50 | 7 days / 5.00 / 30.00 |
| Lease Buyout Loan | 15 days / 4.00 / 25.00 | 10 days / 5.00 / 18.50 | 7 days / 5.00 / 30.00 |
| New Vehicle Loan | 15 days / 4.00 / 25.00 | 10 days / 5.00 / 18.50 | 7 days / 5.00 / 30.00 |
| Green Vehicle Loan | 15 days / 4.00 / 25.00 | 10 days / 5.00 / 18.50 | 7 days / 5.00 / 30.00 |

## Quick answers

**Which state has the shortest grace?** Virginia, 7 calendar days.

**Which state has the lowest cap?** South Carolina, 18.50 USD per installment.

**Does the product change the schedule?** No. Only the borrower's state changes which row applies.
